s: Welcome back to Word Kitchen, the podcast where we cook up new English words.
Today we are talking about a warm topic: family and relationships.
We all have a family, and family words are so useful in English.
Today we will learn ten new words together.
An aunt is the sister of your mother or father.
My aunt is my mother's sister, and she is very funny.
My aunt is my father's sister.
Do you see your aunt often, Lena?
I see my aunt every weekend.
My aunt lives near my house.
My aunt is one of my favorite people.
An uncle is the brother of your mother or father.
My uncle is my father's brother.
My uncle is a good cook, and my uncle loves football.
My uncle lives in another city, but my uncle calls me every Friday.
My uncle and my aunt come to our house for big holidays.
My uncle always tells funny stories at dinner.
A cousin is the child of your aunt or uncle.
So if your aunt has a son, he is your cousin.
My cousin and I are the same age.
My cousin and I play football after school.
Do you like your cousin, Maya?
Last month, my cousin came to my house, and my cousin stayed for two days.
My cousin is my best friend in the family.
Now we have two words for the children of your brothers or sisters.
A nephew is the son of your brother or sister.
So if your brother has a little boy, that boy is your nephew.
My nephew is five years old.
My nephew asks a million questions!
My sister has a son too, so I have a nephew.
My nephew and I play with cars on the floor.
My nephew is three, and my nephew is very funny.
And our next word is niece.
A niece is the daughter of your brother or sister.
My brother has a daughter, so she is my niece.
My niece loves to draw pictures.
My niece reads books to me, and my niece sings songs all day.
My niece is a little star.
A grandchild is the child of your son or daughter.
So a grandchild can be a boy or a girl.
The woman plays with her grandchild every day.
If you are a grandfather or grandmother, your son's child is your grandchild.
My grandmother has one grandchild, me!
My neighbor is a grandmother, and her grandchild visits every Saturday.
The grandchild and the grandmother bake bread together.
Married means having a husband or wife.
He is married to a kind woman.
They got married two years ago.
They have been married for twenty five years.
Married people love and help each other.
My aunt and uncle are married too.
She is single and lives alone.
He says he will get married one day, but for now he is single.
Some people are married, some people are single.
She is single and she travels a lot.
A baby is a very young child.
The baby is six months old.
The baby sleeps a lot, and the baby eats many times a day.
When I visit my sister, the baby smiles at me.
A baby changes a family in a beautiful way.
And our last word is teenager.
A teenager is a person between thirteen and nineteen years old.
My nephew will be a teenager in eight years.
A teenager goes to school and has many friends.
As a teenager, my cousin plays football and listens to music.
Teenagers have a lot of energy.
My neighbor's son is a teenager.
Being a teenager is fun and busy.
Let us say all ten words one more time.
Aunt, uncle, cousin, nephew, niece, grandchild, married, single, baby, teenager.
Thank you for listening to Word Kitchen.
